summary.name: Postorius
summary.one_liner: Postorius is the web user interface for managing GNU Mailman mailing lists, listed on awesome-selfhosted as a GPL-3.0 Python project.
use_cases: Managing GNU Mailman mailing lists through a browser
Hosting self-hosted mailing lists and newsletters
Administering list subscribers and settings via a web UI
Providing a web front end for a Mailman 3 installation
summary.what_it_does: The page is the GitLab repository for Postorius, the web user interface for GNU Mailman. The listing describes it as a web UI for accessing GNU Mailman, and it is categorized on awesome-selfhosted under mailing lists and newsletters. The page text shows the repository's git revisions, with master as the default branch and about 20 tags (the newest listed is v1.3.13). The page text itself contains no feature descriptions, so specific capabilities beyond the web front end for Mailman are not confirmed here.
notable: Web front end for GNU Mailman
caveats: Page text is mostly repository navigation; few features are described
Requires a GNU Mailman installation to work with
